requirements.statement: A productive-capital funding settlement receipt must bind the exact CapitalAuthorization v2 and exact PaymentIntent economics, including project, payer, payee, asset, amount, purpose and idempotency key; a recomputed receipt hash cannot override authorization mismatch.

A project-revenue SettlementReceipt v2 must bind the project, CapitalAuthorization v2 and ProjectEvidence v1, but settlement evidence alone must never claim consolidated revenue or profit recognition.
Financial OS must independently compare SettlementReceipt v2 funding economics against authoritative CapitalAuthorization v2; receipt integrity alone is insufficient for canonical causal evidence.

A settled project-revenue payment must not be posted as EXTERNAL_REVENUE without a separate Financial OS revenue-recognition decision proving external counterparty, contract/invoice, delivery/performance, dispute/refund, tax and FX/accounting-policy evidence.

The canonical external-revenue posting path must re-evaluate raw recognition evidence immediately before ledger mutation, reject deferred/rejected recognition, preserve tax/refund reserves as liabilities and bind the ReportingEntry evidence digest to RevenueRecognition v2.

EconomicCycleTrace v4 must prove the explicit causal chain Revenue Settlement -> Revenue Recognition -> Ledger Event before Accounting Snapshot, including exact digest and effective-time links; the trace itself has no posting or execution authority.

Latest trust commitments must bind an explicit immutable schema-policy generation and create commitments from the latest schema for each domain by default while retaining explicit provenance verification for older generations.

Superseded receipt, authorization, trace, trust and recognition generations must remain preserved as provenance; corrections must be introduced through explicit side-by-side generations or append-only overlays rather than destructive rewrites.
